heroHeadline: Paperwork Backlogs Strip DACA Recipients of Legal Status, Creating New Undocumented Immigrants
heroSubtitle: Federal administrative delays are causing DACA renewal applications to lapse, stripping recipients of protected status and effectively generating new undocumented immigrants through bureaucratic failure rather than enforcement action.
